relationships.subject: miR-216a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: HMGB1 was identified as a target of miR-216a-5p by luciferase reporter system.

relationships.subject: miR-216a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS exposure enhanced the protein expression levels of HMGB1, TLR4 and p-p65 NF-kB in microglia, which were abrogated following miR-216a-5p overexpression

relationships.subject: miR-216a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: Ectopic expression of miR-216a-5p suppressed microglial marker IBA-1 expression and subsequent pro-inflammatory cytokine releases (IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α) from LPS-activated microglia

relationships.subject: miR-216a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal delivery of LV-miR-216a-5-p ameliorated CFA-evoked mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia in mice.

key_findings: miR-216a-5p targets HMGB1 and suppresses HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kB signaling in microglia
Intrathecal miR-216a-5p overexpression ameliorated CFA-induced hyperalgesia
